title.en: An Act to Amend Act Numbered thirty-Nine Hundred and Eighty-Nine, Entitled "An Act Authorizing the Public Welfare Commissioner to Arrange With Any Existing Entity Engaged in the Horse-Racing Enterprise for the Holding of Horse Races for Only One Time and for Charitable Purposes, and to Sell Tickets At a Price to Be Fixed By Him, to Be Drawn By Lots in Connection With the Races, and for Other Purposes," as Amended By Act Numbered Four thousand and Forty-Eight.

text.en:
Section one of Act Numbered Thirty-nine hundred and eighty-nine, as amended by Act
Numbered Four thousand and forty-eight, is hereby further amended to read as follows:
"Section 1. As an emergency measure, the celebration of a charity horse race sweepstake once a year is hereby
authorized under the conditions provided in this Act.
"The celebration of the said charity horse race sweepstake shall be made under the supervision and control of
a board of trustees composed of nine members, including the Secretary of Finance who shall be ex officio
chairman, The other members shall be appointed by the Governor-members. General upon the
recommendation of the Secretary of Finance. The members shall be citizens of the Philippine Islands or of the
United States but any three thereof may be subjects or citizens of three different foreign countries, residing in
the Philippine Islands. They shall serve for one year unless reappointed and shall not receive any remuneration
or salary for their services.
"The board of trustees shall have the following powers and duties: To adopt rules and regulations governing
the yearly celebration of the charity horse race sweepstake and the sale of the tickets thereof; to fix the date of
the horse race each year and the closing of the sale of tickets; to supervise the administration of said races
which shall for a fixed period be in the hands of one or several of the charitable associations mentioned in
section two of this Act, which shall be previously designated by the board of trustees and shall, upon being so
designated, carry out the resolutions and wishes of the board of trustees; appoint the necessary clerical force,
to fix their salaries, and to remove them for cause; to buy, purchase, lease, rent or hire such property, real or
personal, as may be necessary and advisable in carrying out the charity horse race sweepstake, and to enter
into such contracts, agreements, or obligations, as may be necessary and indispensable for carrying out the
purpose of this Act; and to do such act or acts incidental to the powers herein granted and such other act or
acts as may be necessary and proper for the carrying out of the purpose of this law."

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, November 29, 1933.
